title: Nose, Stomach, and Throat
label: ch:it-nose-stomach-throat
canDo: I can name my nose, stomach and throat in Italian, closing the body-word set Chapter 17 opened.

payoff.summary: The chapter's last lesson gathers il naso, lo stomaco and la gola, closing the seven-word body set begun in Chapter 24, and lays out the five different kinds of word-history behind those seven words in one place.
